name: nika
description: DeepSeek language model provider for VS Code Copilot Chat, with configurable vision preprocessing (Gemma 4 via Ollama or Gemini)

nika.selectedModel.description: The DeepSeek model to use for chat

enumDescriptions: 4,096 tokens — Minimal, fastest. Good for simple Q&A.
8,192 tokens — Default. Balanced for most conversations without thinking mode.
16,384 tokens — Thinking mode sweet spot. Reserves ~8K for reasoning + ~8K for visible output.
32,768 tokens — Large responses for complex code generation and analysis.
65,536 tokens — Very long outputs for document generation and large refactors.
131,072 tokens — Extended output for heavy agent sessions.
384,000 tokens — Maximum DeepSeek V4 output capability.
nika.maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per response. DeepSeek V4 supports up to 384K tokens. When thinking mode is on, choose at least 16K so reasoning tokens don't consume the entire budget.

enumDescriptions: Maximum reasoning effort (used for complex agent tasks)
nika.thinkingEffort.description: Thinking/reasoning effort level. Only applicable when using a model that supports thinking (e.g., DeepSeek V4 Pro). Higher effort produces more thorough reasoning but slower responses.

nika.visionModel.description: Vision model for image preprocessing. Gemma 4 runs locally via Ollama (no API key needed). Gemini uses Google AI Studio (free tier, needs API key).

nika.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Ollama server URL. Points to localhost by default, but can be any remote Ollama instance (e.g., http://192.168.1.100:11434). Used when vision model is Gemma 4.

enumDescriptions: 65,536 tokens — Small, good for simple Q&A
131,072 tokens — Balanced, recommended for most use cases
262,144 tokens — Large, for complex document analysis
524,288 tokens — Extra large, for very long conversations
1,000,000 tokens — Maximum, full DeepSeek context for complex agent tasks
nika.contextWindow.description: Maximum input context window. Limits how many tokens of conversation history are sent to DeepSeek. Smaller windows are faster and cheaper; larger windows capture more context. Applies to all models.
